title: Task 1: Restore Objects extraction and add section anchors
description:
Objective:
Restore correct column order for the Objects source page and add bounded Madness/Objects section anchors.

Files:
- Modify: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/extract.ts
- Modify: packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sections.ts
- Test: packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/extract.test.ts
- Test: packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sections.test.ts

Steps:
1. RED: Add an extractor fixture with two supported page columns plus five justified far-right fragments. Assert the complete left column precedes the complete right column and the five fragments remain joined to their right-column lines. Add section tests asserting madness starts at /^Madness$/, ends at Objects, and objects starts at /^Objects$/, ends at Poisons; both require heading matches and required end boundaries.
2. Run: npx vitest run packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/extract.test.ts packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sections.test.ts
Expected: FAIL because the five-item island is selected as a phantom column and the anchors do not exist.
3. GREEN: Raise the existing justified outlier-island ceiling from 3 to 5 with comments explaining the reviewed SRD pages. Add madness and objects to SRD_5_1_DEFAULT_SECTION_ANCHORS and Srd51SectionAnchors. Do not add page-number branches.
4. Re-run the focused tests; expect PASS.
5. REFACTOR: Keep the partition selection generic and comments accurate, then run npm run typecheck.
design: The existing partitioner already compares the widest valid x-gap with the most supported split. Only expand TINY_OUTLIER_SIDE_MAX_ITEMS to five so the supported structural gutter wins for the reviewed five-fragment pattern. Anchors use matchHeadings: true and requireEndHeading: true: madness is bounded by Objects, objects by Poisons.
acceptance_criteria:
- Synthetic five-fragment extractor regression passes without page-specific logic.
- madness and objects anchors match only exact headings, require their end headings, and are part of Srd51SectionAnchors.
- Focused tests and npm run typecheck pass.
close_reason: Restored vendored Objects page column order and added bounded Madness/Objects anchors; focused tests and typecheck pass.
